name: btc_market
description: Read public Binance USD-M futures ticker, candles (optional multi-timeframe), funding, snapshot or historical OI, and long/short ratio. Descriptive window statistics, not trade signals. Read-only; no orders.

symbol.description: Binance USDT-M futures symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT

interval.description: Kline interval; long/short uses 5m for 1m, 6h for 8h, and 1d for 1w, reported as long_short.period. long_pct/short_pct are percentages (0..100).

include.description: Sections to fetch; OI history is opt-in, other sections default on.

intervals.description: Optional 1..4 unique kline intervals, must include interval (default 1h). Total intervals * limit <= 400. OI/ratio use primary interval only.
